arguments.query: code review approvals before merge to main branch

answer:8007a6fb-e37f-4628-b519-4f9f0c6e2: Yes. Changes to the default branch of our application repository (harborlight/app on GitHub) require two approving reviews before they can be merged, and the rule applies to administrators as well.
answer:6a3f9bed-a7a4-46f7-8bbd-58b70111a: Yes. GitHub secret scanning is switched on for our application repository (harborlight/app).
answer:bee91ae7-f592-4baf-9a90-2cb2ddbbf: Yes. Our GitHub organisation (harborlight) requires two-factor sign-in for all of its members.
answer:47ea8ebe-f612-4f45-8648-28ddef7c3: Infrastructure and container images are scanned weekly. Critical findings are fixed within 7 days and high findings within 30 days.
answer:4882d36d-baeb-4a23-9bad-c26b73ad8: An independent firm performs a penetration test of the application and infrastructure once a year. A summary letter is available under NDA.
